name: meilisearch
description: A lightning-fast search engine API bringing AI-powered hybrid search to your sites and applications.
readme: ⚡ A lightning-fast search engine that fits effortlessly into your apps, websites, and workflow 🔍 Meilisearch is a search engine for fast, relevant full-text, semantic, and hybrid search. The easiest way to get started and run it in production is Meilisearch Cloud: create a project and run your first search in minutes, with no servers to deploy, upgrade, or maintain. The engine is open source under the MIT license, so you can also self-host it.
